sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay mechanics of Letter Connect are simple yet addictive. The game presents you with a grid of letters, and your goal is to find all hidden words within these letters. You can connect the letters in any way you like to take the word, but be careful - each level comes with a specific set of rules and restrictions that you need to follow.

To start, you can use any of the given letters to create a word. As you create words, the game will reward you with points and badges, which will help you unlock new levels and features. But don't get too comfortable - the game will also introduce challenges and obstacles that will test your skills and strategy.

One of the key features of Letter Connect is its use of word patterns and connections. As you create words, you'll notice that the game will often highlight specific letters or patterns within the grid. These patterns are crucial to solving the puzzle and can often lead to new and exciting word connections.

The game also introduces a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can help you progress through the levels. These power-ups can be used to reveal hidden words, remove obstacles, or even swap letters within the grid. With its unique blend of word search and puzzle gameplay, Letter Connect is a game that will challenge your vocabulary, spelling skills, and strategic thinking.
